Primary live inspection covered statewide screener and Fresno role, transfer, mailing/language, five child slots, agriculture, call-time and referral-source follow-ups. No Submit/CAPTCHA/server validation attempted.
Fresno is representative research county, not asserted user residence; local agency intakes differ.
No accounts, contacts, requests, signatures, uploads or submissions performed.
No self-entered numeric income comparison control observed in statewide screener; household-size result is informational, not certification.
Referral/policy fields are appointment/provider/staff data, not universal online application requirements.
Posted physical-presence waiver expires 2026-09-30 or as communicated; post-expiry extension not found. Phone preference does not prove entirely remote certification available now.
Required conditional records indicate applicable process, not blanket requirement for all applicants. Public not_marked does not prove optional server validation.
No SSN or immigration/citizenship data field found in reviewed screener/Fresno intake; do not import BenefitsCal SSNs into WIC intake.
BenefitsCal answers can be reused as candidates only after person match, current-data review and WIC-specific household rules.
Primary Fresno live inspection found no income amount, SSN, or document-upload controls across exposed intake; absence does not establish all certification data requirements.
